header.userPrompt: Fix https://github.com/VirtusLab/orca/issues/191: build.sbt isolates test git via GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null in Test / envVars, but git also reads config from GIT_CONFIG_COUNT / GIT_CONFIG_KEY_<n> / GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_<n> (git 2.31+), which the forked test JVM inherits. GitRepoTest ('a fixture repo sees no global or system git config') fails when e.g. GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=commit.gpgsign, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false are set. Fix: add "GIT_CONFIG_COUNT" -> "0" to Test / envVars next to the two existing entries (git ignores KEY/VALUE pairs when the count is zero). Verify GitRepoTest passes with those env vars exported. The PR body should reference the issue with 'Fixes #191'.
